commit_type.instructions: Which Conventional Commits type fits this change?

criteria.feat: Adds a new feature, skill, tool, or option
criteria.fix: Fixes a bug or wrong behavior
criteria.chore: Upkeep with no behavior change, such as a dependency bump, config sync, or cleanup

docs_only.instructions: Are all the changed files Markdown or documentation files?

criteria.env: The machine, network, disk, credentials, or a missing service
criteria.flaky: Timing, ordering, or randomness that would likely pass on a retry
criteria.code: A bug in the code under test

grep_relevance.instructions: Does opening this search hit help with the task?

review_comments.instructions: What must the author do with this review comment?

criteria.fix: It names a real defect that a user could hit
criteria.dismiss: A style nit, a preference, or a false alarm with no defect
criteria.ask: It is unclear what the reviewer wants

playbook_routing.instructions: Which kind of work is this request?

criteria.bug-fix: A reported defect to reproduce and fix
criteria.investigation: A read-only question about how or why
